notes: New Start button logos, drawn in higher quality: Glass, Aurora, Sunset, Candy, RGB gamer, Minimal, three Neon outlines, seven glass orbs in a chrome ring (Aero, Ember, Emerald, Amethyst, Gold, Obsidian, Chrome), Hex badge, Diamond, Power and Gamepad, besides Windows default and RapTech. The old premade logos are gone; a computer that used one shows Windows default until a new one is picked. On a computer with the guard service, Windows' own Start and Search programs are now stopped while the RapTech Start panel is installed, which frees memory; after Uninstall they run again from the next sign-in. Goes with counter 1.50.0.
